title: Git Index Lock Auto-Cleanup
desc: Built-in harness mechanism to auto-remove stale git index.lock files after 60s without active git process.
steps: THE MECHANISM: git index.lock auto-cleanup (harness built-in). When a git command is blocked because .git/index.lock exists, the harness checks if the lock file is older than 60s and no git process is holding it open. If BOTH are true, it auto-removes the stale lock and retries.
WHEN IT HAPPENS: You run wkpush.sh -m FILE1 FILE2 and git fails with fatal: unable to create .git/index.lock: File exists. Harness detects stale lock, removes it, reruns command, and succeeds.

WHAT YOU DO: If index.lock is fresh (<60s) or held by running git, WAIT 20 seconds and RETRY. If stale (>60s, no git running), TRUST THE HARNESS auto-cleanup, OBSERVE BLOCKED NOTHING TO APPROVE, and VERIFY with git show origin/main:FILE.
LIVE EVIDENCE: Source in kih/wkharness.ps1 (git-blocked-land-it.sh v1.29, step 6). Deployed 2026-10-05, example commit d69b080b.
BANDAID DANGER (NEVER DO): Never manually rm .git/index.lock or Remove-Item while git might still be active. Let the harness safely verify process state and age.
EDGE CASES: Fresh lock (<60s): wait 20s, retry. Fresh lock + running git: wait 20s, retry. Stale lock + no running git: harness auto-removes. Stale lock + running git: wait 20s.

requirements.expect: pushes file or triggers auto-cleanup retry
